Marissa (Finance): FYI — Acme Health (acct: ACME-873) opened a billing dispute for INV-2026-0143. They say the overage charges are incorrect; their usage shows 0 for the period but invoice billed $1,350. Looking like promo credit didn't apply during the run. Can we discuss issuing a promo credit + a goodwill refund? Need approval before manual adjustment.
Drew (Billing Ops): Can you paste the billing run rows? which promo ID? also did they hit any rate-limit refunds or seat changes? I can pull the run and logs.
Marissa (Finance): Quick snippet from the run (sanitized):
```
invoice_id,account_id,period_start,period_end,plan,usage_tokens,overage_charge,promo_id,applied_credit
INV-2026-0143,ACME-873,2026-02-01,2026-02-28,enterprise,0,1350,PROMO-APR24,0
```
Looks like PROMO-APR24 should have applied a $150 promo credit per contract but wasn't applied. Customer also flagged an unexpected surge billing on fine-tuning experiments we think was mis-attributed; customer requesting $1,200 goodwill to cover dev time.
Drew (Billing Ops): Got it. So total requested adjustment = $150 (missed promo) + $1,200 (goodwill) = $1,350. Before we apply manual credit I need finance approval + GL allocation for JE.
Nina (Finance Manager): Approve the manual credit as described but flag: goodwill refunds >$1k require manager ok — I approve this one given the evidence and CS context. Please put GL code 6405 for customer credits and include reason: "Promo miss + goodwill refund — Acct ACME-873."
Khalid (Revenue Ops): I will create the manual credit. Double-checking: apply a negative invoice line item and create JE. I'll follow standard manual-adjust flow and tag doc with dispute ticket DT-9872.
BillingBot: Audit log — manual credit workflow initiated by Khalid at 2026-03-16T14:08:12Z. Request ID: RB-cc-1758001234.
Khalid (Revenue Ops): Done. Manual credit applied on invoice INV-2026-0143: -$1,350. JE created: JE-2026-0721. GL: 6405. Notes: PROMO-APR24 ($150) + goodwill ($1,200). Refund method: account credit (no ACH refund). Posting ETA to ledger: EOD today.
Jasmine (Customer Success): Noted. I'll follow up with Acme and confirm they see the credit applied. Please do not auto-refund to card; they asked for account credit. Will confirm acceptance of goodwill.
Marissa (Finance): Thanks — please attach the JE and dispute ticket to the customer record and mark this resolved. Reminder to Billing Ops: let's add a postmortem step to catch promo ID mapping during billing run so PROMO-APR24 doesn't get missed next month.
Drew (Billing Ops): Will add an extra validation step in the billing preflight: check promo_id mappings exist for all enterprise accounts. I'll add a one-line test in the billing run and notify infra if mapping missing.
Nina (Finance Manager): Also, tag this for weekly reconciliations. If we see a pattern (same promo missed multiple times) escalate to product for promo engine bug.
Marissa (Finance): Customer Success update: Acme confirmed the credit is visible and appreciated the goodwill. Customer said they'd continue renewal. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
